# Pull request

Use the common artifact header for versioned artifacts. For GitHub records, include the relevant identity and source fields in the existing issue or PR.

## Change and reason

[Complete with the problem, resulting behavior and linked issue or requirements. For an epic PR, link the epic and every required merged issue PR.]

## Scope and identity

[Complete with head and base branches, current head and base SHAs, and approved sources.]

## Validation

[Complete with per-AC evidence and test, lint, build and security scan links. For an epic PR, include combined QA results. Keep missing results visible.]

## QA and human decision

[Complete with quality recommendation link and exact-head merge or production decision.]

## Deployment and recovery

[Complete with applicable artifact/configuration identity, deployment verification, migration and rollback links.]
